introHtml: Eddie Bauer drinkware combines rugged outdoor style with reliable performance, making it a smart choice for corporate gifts, event giveaways, and employee recognition. These insulated bottles and mugs keep beverages at the right temperature during long meetings, trade shows, or outdoor team-building activities. With your logo imprinted via screen printing or laser engraving, each piece becomes a durable reminder of your brand. Choose from stainless steel tumblers, travel mugs, and water bottles that reflect the quality your team and clients deserve.
